# Safe template for local secret-scanner tests.
#
# The original spike intentionally used synthetic values shaped like real
# secrets, but GitHub push protection blocks those committed strings even when
# they are fake. Keep this file in git as the documented fixture contract and
# generate scanner-triggering values locally with:
#
#   pwsh ./generate_fake_secrets.ps1
#
# The generated file is written under .generated/ and is ignored by git.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=<generated locally>
aws_secret_access_key=<generated locally>
github_token=<generated locally>
slack_token=<generated locally>
